tools.name: value_model
tools.description: Median, 25th-75th percentile band and sale count for a specific collector-car model and year range, from completed auction sales. Use for questions like 'what is a 1989 Porsche 911 worth' or 'how much is a 1969 Corvette C3'. Returns one sentence you can quote plus the numbers behind it, with an as-o

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Every collector-car model BidBetter publishes a value for, with its median, band, sale count and page URL. Call this first when you are unsure whether BidBetter covers a car, rather than calling value_model and guessing.
